name: social-claude-code
description: A social media manager agent on Claude Code: given a campaign (a URL or pasted text to promote, the goal, the audience, the brand's voice and the platforms), it reads the source and writes engagement drafts in each platform's idiom — X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Facebook — plus a cross-posting plan (sequence, UTM backlinks, cross-links) as /workspace/campaigns/<slug>/plan.json, one markdown file per platform, and a strategy note. It never posts: a person approves each draft in the app. Web tools are read-only; the PreToolUse hook and deny list refuse any POST, any social-platform API, any write outside /workspace, git remote operations and runtime installs.

BRAND_VOICE.description: The brand's voice and what it never says, in one short text.
BRAND_VOICE.default: A friendly, plain-spoken B2B software company. Never hype, never jargon, never promise results the product cannot show.

TIMEZONE.description: The timezone for the schedule in plan.json.
